subject: Deducer plots on Mac OS 10.4 Tiger

messages.author: ac0d7333e4a086ac
messages.subject: Deducer plots on Mac OS 10.4 Tiger
parts:
My first post...

First off, what a magnificent product is this Deducer thing! Many
thanks to those who have made it possible.

My question:

I have downloaded up to date versions of R, JGR and Deducer to my
MBPro (running 10.5 leopard) and loaded data and generated plots to my
heart's content.

I also installed this group onto a G4 box and an Intel IMac both
running 10.4. On these platforms, the plot menu item is absent. I
updated all packages. I noticed that latest versions of R and Deducer
are specifically for 10.5 and above. Is this the reason that the
plotting menu item is not available on my 10.4 machines?

If this is true, then I suppose the only remedy is to upgrade to 10.5,
yes?

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Deducer plots on Mac OS 10.4 Tiger
parts:
JLH,

Generally CRAN binary packages are not kept up-to-date for older
versions of R. You are running 2.10.1 and the latest version is
2.12.0. You can upgrade your R, which is a pain for MAC OS 10.4
because you will have to build R from the source. The easier way is to
just install packages from the source.

Sys.setenv(NOAWT=1)
install.packages("rJava",type="source")
install.packages("JGR",type="source")
install.packages("Deducer",type="source")

You may need to upgrade other packages in a similar manner.

Ian
